the reproducibility (reliability) of exercise-induced ventricle arrhythmias is low, even when measured at short intervals, and that the reproducability of continuous measures of arrhythmia frequency is higher than that of categorical measures.

the reproducibility for exercise-induced ventricular ectopy was highest when the intertest interval was 1 to 3 weeks.
the reproducibility for exercise-induced ventricular tachycardia was poor, but the reproducibility was better for ventricular tachyarrhythmia and for premature ventricular complexes.

the reproducibility for the presence or absence (categorical) of ventricular arrythmia is poor.
the frequency of premature venticular complexes can be used to assess the clinical significance of ventricular arrythmias.
